name: Pole Training
description:
You are trained in the use of the acrobat's pole, a special weapon type.

When you use an action to attack while wielding a pole, you may either make one attack against a foe within the pole's reach or two attacks against adjacent foes.

improvements.name: Vault
improvements.description:
Once per turn, you may choose one:

  • Your jump distance is doubled for your next jump this turn.

  • The height of vertical surface you can run up is doubled this turn.

In either case, the increase does not cost you additional movement.

improvements.name: Spin Attack
improvements.description: When attacking with a pole, you may spend 2 actions instead of 1 to attack all adjacent foes simultaneously with a single attack roll.

improvements.name: Ground Spin
improvements.description: When you use the Spin Attack ability, you may spend an additional half action to roll Dexterity vs Dexterity against each foe you hit, knocking prone each foe that loses their roll.
